intro.title: Access to the automotive ICs your build is waiting on
paragraphs: An automotive build can call for thousands of electronic components, and the technology moves quickly. When a part goes on allocation or a lead time stretches past the build date, the programme does not wait — and that is the point where a supply chain turns risky.

We source against your bill of materials from suppliers we have qualified, quote the whole line rather than one part at a time, and tell you when a reference cannot be sourced instead of substituting it silently. Every order is inspected on arrival at our Shenzhen facility, and anything that needs internal analysis goes to our partner laboratories.

items.title: Strategic Sourcing
items.text: We work from your bill of materials and your approved references, and use our supplier network to find the parts your build needs — telling you plainly when a reference cannot be sourced.

items.title: Quality Assurance
items.text: Every order is checked on arrival at our facility: external inspection under magnification, and laboratory analysis through our partner laboratories when a part needs internal verification.

items.title: Speed to Market
items.text: Stock checks and quotations come back as fast as we can turn them around, and agreed stock can be held against your build schedule so parts are ready when your line needs them.

items.title: Sourcing Technology
items.text: Quotations, lot records and inspection results are held in our own systems, so you can ask what was checked on a specific lot and get an answer.

inspect.title: What happens before your parts ship
inspect.text: Incoming inspection and external visual checks are carried out at our own facility in Shenzhen. Internal analysis — X-ray, XRF, decapsulation, solderability and electrical testing — is carried out by our partner laboratories. We do not operate our own testing laboratory, and we say so plainly so you know exactly who tests your parts.
inspect.alt: An inspector positioning a component under a digital inspection microscope on an anti-static mat

cta.title: Send us your automotive bill of materials
cta.text: Tell us the part numbers, the quantities and your acceptance criteria. We will confirm availability, lead time and exactly how we will inspect the parts before they ship.
